book.name: Madyu
book.title: Madyu Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Madyu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u, wid magö rɨk ñɨŋla
Juda God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u, Jisas bɨ nɨpe gau aip wid wög aŋ au amöl gɨ, bɨ nɨpe gau kɨyö lö, wid magö anɨb gau rɨmnap udöm, hañ pak yuöm, ñɨŋöl gɨ ñɨŋöl gɨ areila.

Anɨg geila, bɨ Perisi gau nɨŋöm, Jisas nɨp hagla, “Lo manö hon hagab, nɨbi bɨ God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u wög gagnaböl. Pen bɨ ne gau nɨhön gɨnɨg God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn wög gagep i, wid magö hañ pak yuaböl?” ö gɨla.

Hageila, Jisas kalɨp haga, “Depid hadame nöp bɨ nɨpe gau aip kɨyö lö, God sabe gep ram u amjaköm, bred God amgö ilö adö au löm, bɨ yɨharɨŋ ñɨŋagpal, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gɨpal gau nöp ñɨŋbal bred u, kalɨp hag nɨŋö nɨp ñɨlö, bɨ nɨpe gau aip ñɨŋla. Pen kɨyö lö gɨla aiud anɨbu, God Manö yaŋ kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla u kale nɨŋagpim ar?

“Kale Mosɨs God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka u nɨŋagpim rö löp. Nɨpe kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga, ‘Bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ gau, God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u, God sabe gep ram raul u am mɨdöm, wög gɨpal. Pen God kalɨp manö kub hagagnab,’ a ga.
Pen yad kalöp hagabin, God sabe gep ram anɨbu nan kub wasö; yad ke pen Bɨ kub yabɨƚ mɨdpin.

Pen manö ap God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla u, nɨŋ aij gagpim akaŋ Manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla, ‘Nɨbi bɨ yɨp nan pak sabe gɨ ñɨnaböl u, yɨp aij gagnab; nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp mög nɨŋnaböl u, yɨp aij gɨnab,’ a gɨla. Manö anɨbu nɨŋmim gagpim u me, bɨ yad gau gɨ aij gɨlö nɨŋöl gɨ, kalɨp ud sɨƚɨk hagpe.
‘God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn! God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn!’ a gɨpim u pen Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe nöp God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn u abad mɨdöp a gɨmim gasɨ u nɨŋagpim.
Jisas bɨ ñɨmagö pɨno ga u gö, kamɨŋ la
Jisas ram mɨnöŋ anɨbu arö göm, ram mɨnöŋ ap aramöm, Juda magum gep ram raul mɨgan u ara.

Pen ram raul mɨgan anɨbu bɨ ñɨmagö pɨno ga ap mɨdeia. Nɨbi bɨ ap mɨdeila gau, Jisas manö rɨmnap hagö nɨp dam manö kub hagun a göm, nɨp manö pir alöm hagla, “God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn i, nɨbi bɨ kamɨŋ lep aka wasö?” gɨla.
Hageila, Jisas kalɨp haga, “Kaj sipsip kale ap God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn i uƚöm mɨgan areinab u, ud yunabim aka wasöŋ Ud yunabim rö löp.
Pen kaj sipsip u nan yɨharɨŋ. Nɨbi bɨ u nan yabɨƚ. God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn i kamɨŋ laŋ a gun gɨnabun u, manö mɨdagöp, gɨnabun,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg hagöm, bɨ ñɨmagö pɨno ga u nɨp haga, “Ñɨn mɨlöbö lɨ!” a ga. Anɨg hagö, ñɨmagö mɨlöbö labin a ga. Anɨg ga nɨŋöm ñɨmagö pɨno ga u böŋ nöp kamɨŋ löm, ñɨmagö böŋ lau aij mɨdeia u rö la.
Anɨg gö nɨŋöm, bɨ Perisi gau am magum göm, nɨp anɨg anɨg gun al pak lun, a göm, manö hag nɨŋ hag nɨŋ gɨla.
Jisas nɨpe God bɨ wög gɨ ñeb nɨpe
Anɨg geila, Jisas nɨŋöm, ram mɨnöŋ anɨbu arö göm, mɨgan ap arnɨg göm ara. Arö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi bɨ iru nöp nɨp hain gɨla. Anɨg geila, nɨbi bɨ nan ga gau, nɨpe gö magöŋhalö kamɨŋ lö nɨŋöl gɨ,
kalɨp haga, “Bɨ u anɨg anɨg göp a gɨmim, hagagmim!” a ga.
Jisas ga anɨbu, bɨ God manö hagep Aisaia gɨnab a ga rö nöp ga. Nɨpe kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm haga,

content.text: “Bɨ yad böŋ nöp hag lɨbin i, wög yad gɨ ñab.
Bɨ yad nɨŋnö, yɨp aij yabɨƚ göp me u.
Ana yad u nɨp aɫ ba gö,
nɨbi bɨ kale aigöl göm asɨ mɨd aij gɨnaböl manö yad u,
nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö hag ñɨnab.
Pen nɨpe nɨbi bɨ gau nɨŋö mulu lugö,
Nɨbi bɨ mɨdpal gau, yɨp nöp nɨŋöl a göm,
Ƚam hoŋ gɨnɨg gö, kaƚasin rɨm lɨlö inmɨdöp rö u kalɨp hagnab.
Nɨpe anɨg göl gɨ damöm me,
God hagöp rö böŋ u apranö,
nan si nan naij gep böŋ u böŋ nöp ap lugnab.
Nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ gau nɨbö gau u rö nöp,
nɨp gasɨ halö abad mɨdeinaböl,” a ga.

content: Jisas nɨpe Bielsebul kƚö udöm nan gagep gab, a gɨla
Bɨ kɨjaki abaŋ alö, amgö we göm, maj hañ pɨƚ göm ga bɨ ap dam Jisas mɨdeia au daueila. Jisas kɨjaki u hag höŋ yuö, amgö yabɨƚ nɨŋöm, manö hagöm ga.
Nɨbi bɨ mɨdeila gau, Jisas ga anɨbu nɨŋöm, aiö göm hagla, “Bɨ anɨbi bac Depid Ñɨ nɨpe pör abad mɨdpun u rö löp,” a gɨla.
Pen bɨ Perisi gau manö anɨbu nɨŋöm, gasɨ kale gau nöp nɨŋöm hagla, “Bɨ anɨbu God kƚö nɨpe udöm hag höŋ yuagöp; nɨpe kɨjaki aiön pi nan gau, nap kale Bielsebul kƚö udöm hag yuöp,” a gɨ gasɨ nɨŋla.

Pen gasɨ nɨŋla anɨbu, Jisas ke nɨŋöm, kalɨp haga, “Seden uraköm, nɨbi bɨ nɨpe rɨmnap hag yunab u, aige göm bɨ kub mɨdeinabŋ Ram mɨnöŋ ap, kale ke pen pen hagöm asɨk ke ke lɨnaböl u, ap lug paknaböl. Ram mɨnöŋ kub ap aka nɨbi bɨ iƚ añɨ ap, kale ke pen pen hagöm asɨk ke ke lɨnaböl u, ap lug paknaböl. Kale anɨbu rö hagabim u pen Seden nɨpe yam nɨpe ke gau kalɨp hag yuagnab.

“Yɨp hagpim, ‘Kɨjaki aiön pi nan gau nap kale Bielsebul kƚö u udmön hag höŋ yuban,’ a gɨpim u pen kale yɨp hagpe nɨŋɨn: bɨ kale ke gau Bielsebul kƚö u udöm kɨjaki aiön pi nan gau hag höŋ yubal aka nɨhön? Kale ke hagnaböl, ‘Nɨbi bɨ ap anɨg göl rö lagöp,’ a gɨnaböl.
“Pen God Ana kƚö u udem, kɨjaki aiön pi nan gau hag höŋ yuabin u, nɨhön gɨnɨg God bɨ nɨpe nɨbi bɨ udöm abad mɨdeinab ñɨn u hadö auöp i a gɨmim yɨp udagpim?
“Bɨ kƚö yabɨƚ ap mɨdö, nan nɨp gau udnɨg, yɨharɨŋ aragnaböl. Nɨp böŋ nöp nagɨ adɨk löm me, amöm nan nɨp gau udnaböl.
“Nɨbi bɨ yad pɨg mɨdpal gau, nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp yad daunaböl. Pen nɨbi bɨ yad wasö gau, nɨbi bɨ yad aunɨg gaböl gau kalɨp rɨdɨk gɨ yunaböl.

Anɨb u, kale nɨŋ aij gɨmim. Nɨbi bɨ gau nan si nan naij nɨhön nɨhön geinaböl u, God nɨŋöm arö gɨnab. Nɨbi bɨ God nɨp manö rɨb junaböl u, u rö nöp God nɨŋöm arö gɨnab. Pen God Ana nɨp manö rɨb junaböl u, God nɨŋöm arö gagnab.
Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe u nɨp manö naij hageinaböl u, God nɨŋöm arö gɨnab. Pen Ana Uɫ nɨp manö naij hageinaböl u, ñɨn i abe, ñɨn hain u abe, God nɨpe nɨŋ nöp mɨdöm arö gagnab.
Manö ke hagpim adö u kalöp manö kub hagnab

“Kale yɨp nɨhön gɨnɨg hagpim, ‘Seden abaŋ alö, wög aij u göp,’ a gɨpimŋ Mab aij gau magö aij pɨlnab; mab naij gau magö naij pɨlnab. Mab magö pɨlnab magö anɨbu nɨŋöm me, mab u aij mab u naij a gɨnaböl.

Kale haiŋo ñɨ pai yag daubal gau me anɨg hagabim. Kale nɨbi bɨ naij anɨbu rö, aige gɨmim manö aij hagnabimŋ Nɨbi bɨ manö hagpal rö nɨŋnabun me, hibur gasɨ mɨdmagö kalɨp aŋ daŋ nɨhön rö mɨdöp u nɨŋnabun.
Nɨbi bɨ aij gau, hibur gasɨ mɨdmagö aŋ kale daŋ nan aij mɨdöp nɨŋöm gɨ aij gɨpal; nɨbi bɨ naij gau, hibur gasɨ mɨdmagö aŋ kale daŋ nan naij mɨdöp nɨŋöm gɨ naij gɨpal.
Nɨŋ aij gɨmim. Hainö manö kub hagep ñɨn u, God nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp magöŋhalö, manö haƚöwaƚö hagöm nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap gɨ naij gɨla u, nɨhön gɨnɨg anɨg hagpe a göm, kalɨp hag gɨnab.
Anɨb u me, kale ke manö hagnabim u nöp God nɨŋöm hagnab nɨŋöm, kamɨŋ arnabim aka ilön udnabim,” a ga.
Nan gagep rö gö nɨŋun, a gɨla
God lo manö hag ñeb bɨ rɨmnap abe, bɨ Perisi rɨmnap abe, apöm Jisas nɨp hagla, “Manö hag ñeb bɨ! Nan gagep rö ap gö, hon nɨŋun me, ne God nöp hag yuöp auban a gɨnabun,” a gɨla.

Hageila, Jisas haga, “Kale nɨbi bɨ nan si nan naij nöp gɨmim, God manö haga u nɨŋagpim. Nan gagep rö ap gö nɨŋun a gɨpim u, pen kalöp nan ap gɨnö nɨŋagnabim. Bɨ God manö hagep Jona nɨp ga adö u nöp yɨp u rö nöp gö, nɨŋnabim.
Hadame nöp kabsaƚ kub u Jona nɨp pa bo yuö, hibur aŋ yaŋ ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ mɨdöm, ado gɨ aua. Anɨb u rö, yad, Bɨ Ñɨ nɨpe, u rö nöp ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ mɨnöŋ aŋ gau mɨdem, ado gɨ aunabin.

Hadame nöp Jona amöm, daun kub Ninepa nɨbi bɨ kalɨp hagö, nan si nan naij gɨla gau yɨŋɨd arö göm, God nɨp nɨŋ udla. Jona bɨ yɨharɨŋ u hagö nɨŋla; kale pen Bɨ Kub yabɨƚ mɨñi mɨdöp i, manö hagöp u udagpim. Anɨb u, hainö manö kub hagep ñɨn u, Ninepa bɨ kale uraköm kalöp manö kub haglö, kale manö kub udnabim.

“Nɨbi kwin kub, ram mɨnöŋ Siba nɨbö u, hadame nöp ga rö u nɨŋbim. Ram mɨnöŋ nɨpe mɨlö gau nɨbö u pen, Juda kiŋ kub Solomon gasɨ kɨd hiɨk nɨŋeb bɨ u manö nɨp nɨŋnɨg aua. Solomon bɨ yɨharɨŋ u nɨp anɨg ga; pen nɨhön gɨnɨg Bɨ Kub mɨñi mɨdöp i manö hagöp u nɨŋagpimŋ Hainö manö kub hagep ñɨn u, Siba kwin uraköm kalöp manö kub hagö, kale manö kub udnabim.
Kɨjaki aiön pi nan gau kauyaŋ ado gɨ aunɨm rö löp, a ga
“Seden yam nɨpe kɨjaki nan gau ap nɨbi bɨ abaŋ al mɨdöm, höŋ amöm, nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap abaŋ alɨn, a göm, nɨŋ aj wasö nɨŋöm,
ado gɨ apöm nɨŋnab, bɨ nöd arɨk arnab kuö u aij aij nöp mɨdeinab.

Nɨpe nɨŋöm, kɨjaki naij nɨpe rö wasö, kɨjaki naij yabɨƚ, unbö mudun jɨŋ u uɫ gɨ dapöm, bɨ anɨbu nɨp yuö hiɨknaböl. Anɨg gö, nöd mɨd naij ga rö wasö; hainö mɨd naij yabɨƚ gɨnab. Kale nɨbi bɨ uri mɨdpim kale nan si nan naij nöd gɨ mɨdmɨdim rö wasö, hainö nan si nan naij yabɨƚ gɨnabim,” a ga.
Jisas nɨme nɨmam bɨ
Jisas nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp manö hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨme nɨmam nɨpe yabɨƚ gau höŋ yaŋ apöm hagla, “Hon Jisas nɨp manö hagnɨg aubun,” a gɨla.
Hageila, bɨ ap ram raul mɨgan amöm, Jisas nɨp haga, “Name namam ne gau, nöp manö hagnɨg ap mɨdpal höŋ yaŋ,” a ga.
Hageia, nɨbi bɨ nɨpe aip ram raul mɨgan yaŋ mɨdeila gau kalɨp nɨŋ gɨgabö göm haga, “Nɨŋö hagpan u pen, nɨbi bɨ ram raul mɨgan mɨdpal gai i, kale ami yad, mam yad mɨdpal.
Nɨbi bɨ Bapi yad kumi kabö adö laŋ manö hagöp rö nɨŋöm anɨg unbö rö nöp gɨpal gau, ami yad, añ yad, mam yad gau nöp mɨdpal,” a ga.
